question: What result follows from meditating once on the seed in this manner?
premises: One meditates on the seed once in the prescribed manner.
The act produces a relational outcome with all.
inference: Meditating once on the seed in this manner makes one dear to all.
uncertainties: The scope of 'all' (sarvāsāṃ) may refer to all goddesses, powers, or beings depending on context.
plain_english: Thus, having meditated on the seed once, one becomes dear to all.
